name: buffett-code-mcp-server
description: MCP server that accesses the Buffett Code API for Japanese and US company financial data.
long_description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes the Buffett Code API as tools. It provides access to Japanese and US company information including daily/quarterly financials, stock statistics, KPIs, segments, major shareholders, guidance revisions and similar companies. Requires a Buffett Code API key.

tools.name: buffett_code_get_jp_company
tools.description: Get Japanese company information from Buffett Code

tools.name: buffett_code_get_jp_company_daily
tools.description: Get daily Japanese company information from Buffett Code for a specific date

tools.name: buffett_code_get_jp_company_quarterly
tools.description: Get quarterly Japanese company information from Buffett Code for a specific year and quarter

tools.name: buffett_code_get_jp_company_daily_market_reaction
tools.description: Get the daily market reaction for a JP company as both text and stock price change rate.

tools.name: buffett_code_get_jp_company_weekly_stats
tools.description: Get weekly statistics calculated for the company or stock, mainly stock price related statistics.

tools.name: buffett_code_get_jp_company_monthly_stats
tools.description: Get monthly statistics calculated for the company or stock, mainly stock price related statistics.

tools.name: buffett_code_get_jp_company_monthly_kpis
tools.description: Get monthly KPIs for a JP company.

tools.name: buffett_code_get_jp_company_quarterly_long_text_content
tools.description: Get processed long-form text content from securities reports or quarterly reports.

tools.name: buffett_code_get_jp_company_quarterly_major_shareholders
tools.description: Get major shareholders information as listed in a securities report or quarterly report.

tools.name: buffett_code_get_jp_company_quarterly_segments
tools.description: Get segment information as disclosed in a securities report or quarterly report.

tools.name: buffett_code_get_jp_company_annually_guidance_revisions
tools.description: Get a list of earnings guidance revisions by fiscal year for the company or stock.

tools.name: buffett_code_get_jp_company_similarities
tools.description: Get a list of companies similar to the specified company.

tools.name: buffett_code_get_us_company
tools.description: Get company information from Buffett Code

tools.name: buffett_code_get_us_company_daily
tools.description: Get daily company information from Buffett Code for a specific date

tools.name: buffett_code_get_us_company_quarterly
tools.description: Get quarterly company information from Buffett Code for a specific year and quarter

tools.name: buffett_code_get_us_company_stocks
tools.description: Get company stock information from Buffett Code for a specific stock

tools.name: buffett_code_get_us_company_stocks_daily
tools.description: Get daily company stock information from Buffett Code for a specific stock and date

tools.name: buffett_code_get_us_company_stocks_quarterly
tools.description: Get quarterly company stock information from Buffett Code for a specific stock and year-quarter
